verdict.rationale: No evidence of a bulk data-export feature in open/portable formats or account-closure data-portability workflow; evidence only covers APIs, integrations, and MCP connectors for accessing agreement data, not exporting all user data to leave the platform. missing for 10: bulk export/download-all-data feature, open format specification (CSV/JSON/etc.), account closure/data portability documentation, any community confirmation of successful full data export.
